title: Hands-free trunk sensor opening issues
summary: Feedback in this topic centers on the tailgate’s hands-free foot sensor frequently failing to open the trunk consistently, with a smaller set of reports noting the trunk was found open or describing the function without clear sentiment.

negative.summary: Negative reviews describe the kick-to-open trunk feature as inconsistent, requiring repeated attempts or failing to activate when users wave or swipe a foot under the rear bumper.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews mention the trunk opening only once with kick-to-open or being discovered open, but the limited examples do not clearly establish customer sentiment.

signal_notes.interpretation: An exploratory signal indicates BEVE reviews in this topic are more often negative or mixed than the rest of the engine-type breakdown, but this is an observed segment association and not evidence of causation or broader representativeness.

limitations: The sampled examples are heavily concentrated on touch-free sensor inconsistency, so other trunk or tailgate issues may be underrepresented.
Undetermined examples are sparse, limiting confidence about whether those comments reflect malfunction, accidental opening, or simple observation.
This is a stratified sample of topic fragments rather than a random sample, so it should not be treated as representative of all G60 vehicles or owners.
